findings.observation: Previously low-contrast postcard second line now entirely on burgundy after photo was moved down; both lines readable
Pressure sequence central question is partly hidden by large phone and clipboard. The subject and intrusive collage density read well, but full central sentence cannot be read at this sampled moment
findings.scope: Remaining design limitation beyond latest font/wood request

findings.observation: Large numeral3 is cropped by right frame boundary. Action text below reads clearly; no actual visible numeral/action collision despite lint AABB warning

Workflow poster field has independent overlap, angled perspective and edge crops. Major per-card verbs and central documents remain recognizable. Projection overlap warnings do not imply an observed central text collision
Some marketing headlines cross pale photo borders and lose local contrast; some posters repeat stacked identical reading-results words. This reduces polish and content variety
Banner right edge and some banner text crop during initial camera descent, then full AI question reads by settled opening. Sky opening copy starts fully visible and exits upwards as camera descends
Transferred follow-up sheet expands before cut to negative-color monitor flash. Decoded samples confirm physical paper-to-screen handoff and flash at scene boundary
Final calligraphic keyword and supporting CTA centered on spare ivory; clear readable hold

Workflow atlas remains schematic rather than photographic street map
Paper scene is arch, clipboard and paper-transfer still life rather than the source flowing burgundy ribbon

approval: No user aesthetic approval claimed. This review does not certify perfect reference match or full audible playback
